summary: CURE AS (org. no. 817 859 712) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bergen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2016-10-11. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 73.110 (Reklamebyråvirksomhet); it has 16 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 16.3 m and net income was -NOK 99 126. CEO: Brage Istad Brenna-Lund; board chair: Lars Vaagen Solbakken; auditor: CEDRA NORGE AS.
